name: xy-academy-meet
description: XY Academy Meet: video classes for XY Academy, all in this one file. On start it unpacks itself and runs. On Railway: add a Volume at /data and generate a domain (port 8080). Video: set CLOUDFLARE_APP_ID + CLOUDFLARE_APP_SECRET (Cloudflare Realtime), or add a TCP Proxy to port 40000 for the built-in media server. See the README inside (xymeet-app/README.md).
